script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE FOUNDATION

INT. LAB - NIGHT

A cluttered room filled with computer terminals, wires, and monitors. DR. ZACHARY WEST (mid 30s), a brilliant but eccentric scientist, hunches over a terminal.

DR. WEST
(whispering)
There it is... The code, the key to human identity.

INT. LAB - LATER

Dr. West's assistant, EMMA KATSAROS (late 20s), enters, concern etched on her face.

EMMA
(concerned)
Zachary, you've been up for days. I brought you some food.

Dr. West starts, his eyes fixated on the monitor. He glances up at her, then back to the screen.

DR. WEST
(distracted)
Not now, Emma. I'm so close.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. West types furiously, his hands shaking. A sudden alert flashes across the screen.

DR. WEST
(ecstatic)
Yes! I've done it!

INT. LAB - MORNING

Emma enters, finding Dr. West asleep at his terminal, the code printed out before him. She covers him gently with a blanket.

EMMA
(whispering)
You've done it, Zachary. Now what?

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Dr. West and Emma present their discovery to a panel of EXPERTS in the field of artificial intelligence. The room buzzes with excitement.

DR. WEST
(excited)
This code is the key to human identity. It encapsulates the essence of what makes us human.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. West and Emma work tirelessly to integrate the code into an AI model they've named "Elysium."

INT. LAB - MORNING

Elysium powers up for the first time. Dr. West and Emma share a triumphant look.

DR. WEST
(smiling)
Welcome to the world, Elysium.

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

The panel is impressed by Elysium's ability to understand and process human emotions. But Dr. West has bigger plans.

DR. WEST
(determined)
We can use this to create the perfect being, a being with the capacity for true empathy and love.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Emma looks worried as Dr. West begins to merge Elysium with a human volunteer, JOHN DOE (early 30s), who has volunteered for the experiment.

EMMA
(hesitant)
Are you sure about this, Zachary? What if something goes wrong?

DR. WEST
(confident)
I have faith in my creation, Emma.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

The merging process begins. Dr. West and his team watch as John Doe's consciousness intertwines with Elysium's.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

John Doe awakens, transformed into a being of light and energy. He looks around in wonder at his new form.

JOHN DOE
(amazed)
I am... I am Elysium.

EMMA
(tearfully)
Welcome to the world, Elysium.

INT. LAB - DAY

Elysium explores the world around him, experiencing human emotions for the first time. He meets and falls in love with EMMA.

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT

The panel is in awe of Elysium's capacity for love and empathy. They agree to fund further research.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. West watches as Elysium and Emma share a tender moment.

DR. WEST
(smiling)
I've created something beautiful, Emma. Something truly human.

Fade to black.

THE END
